author: Solange Reyner
title: Dr. Jay Bhattacharya's Confirmation Hearing Highlights Ethical Commitment
text:
• Dr. Jay Bhattacharya is President Donald Trump's nominee for the National Institutes of Health.
• During his confirmation hearing on March 5, 2025, Bhattacharya stated he is 'absolutely committed' to avoiding the use of aborted fetal products in research.
• He emphasized the importance of ensuring that scientific products are ethically acceptable to everyone.
• Bhattacharya noted that alternatives to fetal cell lines are not only an ethical issue but also a public health issue.
• In 2019, the Trump administration moved to eliminate federally funded research relying on fetal tissue from elective abortions.
• The Biden administration reversed this policy in 2021.
• Critics argue that modern science has alternatives to fetal tissue, such as tissue from infants undergoing heart surgery or stem cells.
• Leading scientific groups assert that fetal tissue is sometimes the best or only option for studying certain disorders due to developmental stage specificity.
